Local-first, no required cloud account

Chats, memory and the knowledge base stay on this computer by default. Nomi does not run a cloud account; you decide which models to connect.

Local-first

Chats, memory, and knowledge base are stored locally by default — not uploaded to a Nomi cloud (this project doesn’t run that kind of account system).

You’re in control

  • One-click export: export all local data.
  • Editable memory: profile (name, preferences) — view, edit, delete, or export anytime.
  • Local-only file access: when enabled, only local models can read the files you’ve authorized.
  • Encrypted API keys: stored in the system keychain; UI shows masks only.
  • Confirm sensitive actions: MCP tools, file writes, and more ask first; deletes go to trash and can be undone.

What happens with cloud models

When you connect a cloud provider such as OpenAI or Anthropic, chat content goes to that provider under their privacy policy — a connection you configured. Before it’s sent, outbound protection redacts API keys and similar secrets. To keep content on this machine, use a local model.

Optional features default off

Optional features such as proactive chat stay off by default, and you can turn them off again in Settings anytime.
